requirement: Apply an update-antibiotic command to an existing model: copy the name, group ID, and classification, refresh UpdatedAt, keep the identity untouched, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The target model is tracked but not yet saved

inputs.text: Command renaming Amoxicillin to 'Co-amoxiclav', moving it to a new group, and switching to AccessWatch

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with no error
Name, group ID, and classification are overwritten with the command values
UpdatedAt is refreshed and the identity stays unchanged

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
